correctness.rationale: The complete matching recursion has disjoint exhaustive branches, independently checked by an 8x8 permanent subset recurrence (272). Forcing sets are tested against all 272 matchings. The contraction/alternating-cycle correspondence reduces anti-forcing to an exact 8-vertex minimum feedback-arc problem; a subset DP computes the maximum forward arcs and independently enumerating all 40320 orders on one representative per orbit confirms each result. All 384 cube automorphisms produce 8 disjoint orbits totaling 272 and spectra 196/72/4, with full code replayed to VERIFY_OK. Direct Q1–Q3 enumeration establishes the first-gap boundary.

originality.rationale: The exact submaximal anti-forcing distribution 196 at 8 and 72 at 10, first gap at dimension four, and the eight symmetry/forcing-set strata are not implied by Shi–Zhang's known maximum 12/four coordinate extremizers, Lei–Yeh–Zhang's general alternating-cycle criterion, or Deng–Zhang's extremal and polygonal-chain spectra. The closest published research-record matching result classifies prescribed vector differences, not anti-forcing. Source-specific residual access risks are retained.

value.rationale: The anti-forcing spectrum is a natural matching-stability invariant closely tied to the 2004 hypercube forcing program and later continuity questions. The first noninterval spectrum occurs at the canonical four-cube: unlike Q1–Q3, Q4 realizes only the three separated values 8,10,12. The complete submaximal profile and eight symmetry orbits distinguish patterns with identical coordinate-direction multiplicities, refining but not repeating Shi–Zhang's extremal classification. This is a motivated exact classification rather than a small arbitrary parameter slice.
